actions.name: Ram
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3)

actions.name: Bludgeoning damage
actions.text: If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the goat moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 5 (2d4) Bludgeoning damage and has the Prone condition.

traits.name: Illumination
traits.text: The beetle sheds Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 feet.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: The frog can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.text: The frog’s Long Jump is up to 20 feet and its High Jump is up to 10 feet with or without a running start.
